pred_texts: Instruct: Get two slices of bread and toast them in the toaster until nice and crisp for about one minute.
Instruct: You can take both pieces of bread out.
Instruct: Now, place the toasted bread on a microwave-safe plate.
Instruct: Now spread about two tablespoons of pizza sauce on each slice.
Instruct: Spread the pizza sauce evenly on each slice of bread.
Instruct: Now you should add shredded mozzarella cheese on top of one slice of bread, enough cover it with a thin layer of cheese.
Instruct: Now you can add any other toppings that you want in the sandwich.
Instruct: Now you can close the sandwich in the microwave safe plate and microwave it for about 45 to 60 seconds, until the cheese has melted.
